name: Fever
description: Complete guide to Fever: symptoms, causes, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention for patients in India.

seo.title: Fever: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Fever — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Fever is an elevated body temperature, usually a sign that the immune system is fighting infection or inflammation. In tropical India, fever evaluation must consider dengue, malaria, typhoid, and viral illnesses alongside common flu.
riskFactors: Travel to endemic areas without prophylaxis
diagnosis: Complete blood count and peripheral smear
Dengue NS1/IgM, malaria rapid test, blood cultures as indicated
Typhoid Widal or blood culture where appropriate
Urine and chest evaluation if localising signs present
treatment: Paracetamol for comfort (avoid ibuprofen in suspected dengue)
Antibiotics only when bacterial cause confirmed
Antimalarials per national guidelines when malaria diagnosed
Hospital care for warning signs in dengue or persistent high fever
prevention: Mosquito protection in monsoon (nets, repellents, remove stagnant water)
Safe food and water to reduce typhoid risk
Routine vaccinations including influenza where advised
Seek early evaluation if fever lasts >3 days in endemic season
complications: Seizures in young children with high fever

faqs.question: What causes Fever?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Fever curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Fever >3 days without improvement in dengue season
Bleeding, severe abdominal pain, or persistent vomiting
Confusion, rash with hypotension, or breathing difficulty
